description: Apply an RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch document to a target JSON document and return the merged result. A null-valued key in the patch removes that key from the target; a patch that is not itself a JSON object replaces the target wholesale, which is how arrays are replaced rather than merged element by element.

patch.description: The RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch document, as a JSON string

target.description: The target JSON document, as a JSON string

name: apply_json_merge_patch
